Name: Blue Chicken Eggs
Author: dragonsir
Description:
[size=6]COMPATIBLE WITH 1.6 UPDATE[/size]

No longer requires Json Assets.


[line]

[size=5]Features[/size]

I'm sure I'm not the only bothered that white, brown, and golden chickens, ducks, AND ostriches get to lay their own eggs, but BLUE chickens lay WHITE eggs. So, they will now lay blue eggs.

Blue eggs function like brown and white eggs do. They can be used in recipes that require eggs, and the base sell price is 50g (95g for large.)[s]

[/s]Producer Framework Mod no longer necessary.


[size=5]Update Log
[/size]

Version 2.1.0 Fixed the issue with purchasing Blue Chickens from Marnie crashing the animal menu and soft-locking the game. Producer framework mod is not necessary to make mayonnaise with blue eggs, the vanilla game will perform that function by default.
[size=5]
Installation[/size]

[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip this file into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
